comparison.objective: Adjust a cabinet hinge side screw until door reveals are even, then close the door; candidate tunes damping behavior and locks the setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Screwdriver engagement, cam adjustment, and door closing/checking versus loosening a captive lock screw, withdrawing the bit, rotating a separate collar, reacquiring the moved socket, and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Even 3–6 mm reveals, ≤1 mm mismatch, flush closed door, and no clamp-screw sag; candidate requires two safe impact cycles with energy, travel, force, rebound, and drift limits.
comparison.reason: This is the closest static adjustment record, but it tests geometric clearance correction through one screw, not dynamic-response tuning plus a separate moving lock.
